Craftgate

git switch --create craftgate

We founded Craftgate together: Hakan Erdoğan, Sabri Onur Tüzün, Murathan Özcan and I. I am its Chief Software Crafter. It is a payment orchestration platform: an online business integrates once and reaches its banks, payment providers and alternative payment methods through it.

craftgate.io

Story

git log --reverse

We go back a long way. I met Hakan Erdoğan, Craftgate's CEO and co-founder, in 2012 at GittiGidiyor, where he was my manager. Sabri Onur Tüzün and I have worked together at five companies so far, GittiGidiyor, Sony and iyzico among them.

Payments were familiar ground. Hakan and Sabri Onur both had long histories in fintech; Hakan had built and run payment systems at GittiGidiyor and Limango. I came to fintech later, at iyzico in 2017. Between us, we had met the market's hardest problems first-hand.

In 2018 we started Craftbase, a company that built fintech and payment software for clients. Craftgate grew inside it as a product, paid for by that service work, and was introduced publicly in January 2021 as a cloud payment gateway that connects a merchant to every bank's virtual POS from one place. The problem it took on is a costly one: a merchant working with dozens of virtual POS terminals and payment institutions, each with its own commissions, integration and campaign terms, carries a heavy operational load and loses money along the way.

By September 2021, eleven investors had reached out and three large companies wanted to buy Craftgate. We pursued neither. We made the other choice instead: leave a profitable service business and put everything into the product. The team left all service work at the end of 2021, and from 1 January 2022 the company was only Craftgate.

How we work

cat CONTRIBUTING.md

In 2022 I wrote down the foundations of our team culture, in Turkish and later in English. The short version:

  • We are all Crafters.No seniority levels in job titles, and no team leader position.
  • No framework by the book.We don't follow Scrum, Kanban or XP rules. We get to know the team and work on what it needs.
  • Untested development is incomplete development.We write tests until we feel safe putting the change live.
  • Hexagonal architecture.For years it has kept our domain code apart from technology-dependent integration code.
  • One short plan a day, together.Developers, testers, sales and marketing meet for half an hour every day.
  • Remote engineering.The engineering team has worked remotely since March 2020 and plans to stay that way.

Today

git status

As of November 2026.

Craftgate serves more than 600 businesses, among them Beymen, Boyner, MediaMarkt, ebebek, Penti and Karaca. Transaction volume on the platform passed 107 billion TL in 2024. The team is more than 50 people.

Craftgate is not a licensed payment institution, and money never passes through it. Merchants keep their own agreements with banks and payment providers. Craftgate is the technical layer that connects them, routes payments, retries failed ones and watches for problems. It is PCI DSS Level 1 and ISO 27001 certified.

Spain is the first market abroad, with the rest of Europe and Latin America next.
